always-actions.script: if(!sharedMountContext.capabilities.read)throw new Error('Catalog read access is required')

actions.script: if(requested.notified)ec.message.addMessage('Release requested from the method approvers');else if(requested.valid)ec.message.addMessage(requested.message||'Nothing is waiting to be released');else for(const f of requested.findings||[])ec.message.addMessage(f.recordId+': '+f.message,'warning')

container.style: col-12 col-md-auto row items-center q-gutter-xs m-routing-actions

render-mode.text: ${routingState ? '<q-chip dense square class="q-ma-none m-tonal text-' + routingState.color + '">' + WebUtilities.encodeHtml(routingState.text) + '</q-chip>' : ''}

label.text: The draft's checks run first. The method approvers are notified and release it on this routing.
Copies become draft operations of this routing, after its operations. The templates and the other routings stay as they are.

option.text: Remove this routing's current operations in the draft
